title: TOC fields odt 002
notes: real text:table-of-content with text:toc-source (outline level 2) and a text:toc-body holding a single placeholder paragraph (unpopulated TOC; LibreOffice does not auto-update on load), plus 8 text:h headings with text:outline-level 1/2 whose custom paragraph styles also carry style:default-outline-level; 002 adds a real text:a hyperlink (xlink:type="simple", xlink:href="https://example.org", external ref) — only its visible text is reference text, the URL is not. Honest caveat: none of TOC/headings/hyperlink are in the five normative ODF counters (table:table, draw:frame, text:note, text:field, office:annotation), so feature counts stay 0.
